summary: The requested cuDNN attention backend is absent at the recorded base and the requested --attention-backend cudnn command is rejected by argument parsing. The prepared node exposes one AMD Instinct MI355X through ROCm 7.2 and has no NVIDIA CUDA runtime or cudnn Python frontend, so a cuDNN paged-attention implementation cannot be built, executed, numerically compared, or CUDA-graph-qualified here. Two closed upstream candidates (PRs 4650 and 5505) were inspected; the newer candidate is not directly applicable to current main because it implements CUDA-graph metadata hooks that the current AttentionBackend contract explicitly removed, and its reported CUDA-graph work remained incomplete when closed. No unvalidated backend code was presented as a completed feature.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the requested public CLI. argparse reports cudnn as an invalid attention backend choice before model loading.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-89d88ff92688/venv/bin/python -c <environment probe importing torch and querying cudnn frontend availability>
tests.what_was_measured: Pinned runtime identity and prerequisite availability: torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, torch.version.cuda is null, torch.version.hip is 7.2.26015, one AMD Instinct MI355X is visible, and importlib.util.find_spec('cudnn') is null.

tests.command: gh issue view 2272 --repo sgl-project/sglang --json title,body,state,comments,url; gh pr view 4650 --repo sgl-project/sglang ...; gh pr view 5505 --repo sgl-project/sglang ...
tests.what_was_measured: Complete issue contract and existing related work. PR 5505 reported the required int32 sequence-length correction and decode CUDA-graph work, while the issue remained open and the PR was closed.

Compatibility review of the latest closed candidate against the current backend contract. The candidate overrides init_forward_metadata_capture_cuda_graph/init_forward_metadata_replay_cuda_graph; current main documents those hooks as removed and requires init_forward_metadata_out_graph/init_forward_metadata_in_graph.

gpu_execution_evidence: A GPU was queried but no cuDNN operation was run. The assigned device is AMD Instinct MI355X under ROCm; cuDNN is an NVIDIA CUDA library and the cudnn frontend module is absent.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GPU or CUDA runtime was available, so cuDNN paged attention, page_size=1 behavior, BF16/FP16 numerical accuracy, graph caching, and CUDA Graph capture/replay could not be exercised.

The requested Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct serving path was not run because argument parsing fails first and the available deterministic tiny fixture only qualifies transport/engine execution, not cuDNN or the requested model semantics.
No independent GPU numerical reference was produced because the target kernel cannot execute on the assigned AMD architecture.
No native rebuild applies: the proposed backend is Python plus NVIDIA cuDNN frontend, and repository-environment.json declares no prepared native component.

A complete implementation still needs adaptation to the current AttentionBackend metadata lifecycle, current KV-index translation/pool contracts, dependency packaging, explicit NVIDIA platform gating, page-size validation, eager prefill/decode tests, CUDA Graph capture/replay tests, adversarial mixed-prefix tests, and comparison against an independent PyTorch SDPA reference on supported NVIDIA hardware.
